title: Housing restriction policies and internal migration

abstract: When observing spatial data, what standard errors should we report? Within a finite population framework, we identify three channels of possible spatial correlation: sampling scheme, assignment design, and model specification. The Eicker-Huber-White standard error, cluster-robust standard error, and spatial-correlation robust inference are compared under different combinations of the three channels. We prove a finite population central limit theorem for weakly dependent random fields that bridges the gap between superpopulation and finite population inference in our unified framework. These limit theorems are then applied to derive the asymptotic distribution of M-estimators and functions of M-estimators. Based on the decomposition of the finite population variance-covariance matrix of M-estimators, standard errors should be adjusted for spatial correlation when effective assignment variables are spatially correlated and/or spillover effects are specified in the model. In the special case where the sampling probabilities approach zero in the limit, the Eicker-Huber-White and cluster-robust standard errors would be close to the spatial-correlation robust standard errors regardless of the spatial correlation among assignment variables.
abstract_zh: 在观测空间数据时，我们应报告何种标准误？在有限总体框架内，我们识别了可能产生空间相关性的三个渠道：抽样方案、分配设计和模型设定。我们比较了在不同组合下的Eicker-Huber-White标准误、聚类稳健标准误和空间相关稳健推断。我们证明了弱依赖随机场的有限总体中心极限定理，该定理在我们的统一框架中弥合了超总体与有限总体推断之间的差距。这些极限定理随后被应用于推导M估计量及其函数的渐近分布。基于M估计量有限总体方差-协方差矩阵的分解，当有效分配变量存在空间相关性且/或模型中设定了溢出效应时，标准误应针对空间相关性进行调整。在抽样概率极限趋近于零的特殊情况下，无论分配变量间的空间相关性如何，Eicker-Huber-White和聚类稳健标准误将接近空间相关稳健标准误。
title: A design-based approach to spatial correlation
title_zh: 基于设计的方法处理空间相关性

abstract: Conventional approaches to policy design fail to recognise the plasticity of citizens’ beliefs and social preferences. Based on a representative sample from Germany, this column shows that mandated carbon-reducing lifestyle changes such as limiting heating and the use of cars in city centres may crowd out pre-existing green values. Effective climate policy design requires recognising that (a) to succeed, essential policies including bans, carbon taxes, and the promotion of new technologies must be both implementable and politically sustainable, entailing (b) a critical role for citizens’ green values, which (c) may be either diminished or cultivated, depending on policy design.
abstract_zh: 传统的政策设计方法未能认识到公民信念和社会偏好的可塑性。基于德国代表性样本，本专栏指出，诸如限制供暖和市中心汽车使用等强制性的碳减排生活方式改变，可能会挤出既有的绿色价值观。有效的气候政策设计需认识到：（a）要取得成功，包括禁令、碳税及新技术推广在内的关键政策必须既可行又具有政治可持续性，这要求（b）公民的绿色价值观发挥关键作用，而（c）这些价值观可能因政策设计的不同而被削弱或培育。
title: Climate policy may crowd out green values and what to do about it
title_zh: 气候政策可能挤出绿色价值观及其应对之策

abstract: Economists have long viewed monetary policy as influencing labour demand, with little effect on labour supply. This column discusses four studies that use different methods and data from the US, the UK, the euro area, and Australia, and independently find that monetary tightening induces households to adjust their labour supply. Adjustment margins include hours worked, labour market participation, job search, and household balance sheets. These findings illustrate that labour supply is a quantitatively meaningful channel of monetary transmission that has implications for the resilience of labour markets, the interaction of monetary and fiscal policy, and macroeconomic models of monetary transmission.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期以来将货币政策视为影响劳动力需求的因素，而对劳动力供给的影响甚微。本专栏讨论了四项研究，这些研究采用不同方法和来自美国、英国、欧元区及澳大利亚的数据，并独立发现货币紧缩促使家庭调整其劳动力供给。调整的边际包括工作时间、劳动力市场参与度、求职活动以及家庭资产负债表。这些发现表明，劳动力供给是货币传导中一个数量上重要的渠道，对劳动力市场的韧性、货币与财政政策的相互作用以及货币传导的宏观经济模型具有启示意义。
authors: Francesco Bloise, Cristiano Cantore, Mitali Das, Filippo Ferroni, Sebastian Graves, Jonathan Hambur, Klaus Hellwig, Christopher Huckfeldt, Mirko Licchetta, Haroon Mumtaz, Giuseppe Ragusa, John Spray, Eric T. Swanson, Angeliki Theophilopoulou
title: Uncovering the labour supply channel of monetary transmission
title_zh: 揭示货币政策传导的劳动供给渠道

abstract: Demand-side food policies are increasingly recognized as important tools for aligning consumption patterns with climate change mitigation targets, and carbon food labels have attracted growing attention as a potential policy instrument. However, evidence on their effectiveness remains mixed, and causal evaluation results from assessing the effects of carbon food labels in real-world supermarket settings is scarce. This study presents evidence from pre-registered randomized field-embedded survey experiment with behavioral outcomes, combining a representative sample of 2,372 Swiss residents with transaction-level purchasing data covering more than five million daily food purchase decisions made by 1,601 consumers over several years. In collaboration with one of Switzerland’s largest grocery retailers, we evaluate the causal impact of an information treatment designed to increase awareness of one of the world’s first carbon food labels implemented in grocery stores on both stated preferences and revealed purchasing behavior. The results show that the information treatment significantly increases label awareness and leads to small but positive effects on attitudes, perceived behavioral control, and intentions to consider the climate compatibility of food purchases. When tracing these effects into revealed purchasing behavior, the treatment also affects actual food purchases, but effects are modest and heterogeneous across food categories. Rather than inducing broad shifts away from meat consumption, the information treatment primarily leads to a higher overall share of labeled products purchased, increased purchases of labeled convenience products, and a partial reallocation within meat consumption (e.g., lower beef and higher pork purchases). We find no evidence of substantial reductions in overall meat purchases or large cross-category substitutions toward plant-based foods. While heavy meat eaters do not react negatively to the treatment, men and more right-wing individuals show a modest behavioral backlash. Overall, the results suggest that carbon food labels capacity to substantially alter habitual food consumption patterns in stimulus-intensive retail environments is limited and should be thus complemented by additional demand-side measures.
abstract_zh: 需求侧食品政策日益被认为是使消费模式与气候变化减缓目标相一致的重要工具，碳食品标签作为一种潜在的政策手段也引起了越来越多的关注。然而，关于其有效性的证据仍然不一，且在真实超市环境中评估碳食品标签影响的因果评价结果十分稀缺。本研究提供了来自预注册的随机实地嵌入调查实验的证据，并结合行为结果，涵盖了2，372名瑞士居民的代表性样本，以及包含1，601名消费者多年间超过五百万次日常食品购买决策的交易级购买数据。我们与瑞士最大的杂货零售商之一合作，评估了一项旨在提高对杂货店中全球首批碳食品标签之一认知度的信息干预对陈述偏好和揭示性购买行为的因果影响。结果显示，信息干预显著提高了标签认知度，并对态度、感知行为控制以及考虑食品购买气候兼容性的意图产生了虽小但积极的影响。在将这些影响追踪至揭示性购买行为时，干预也影响了实际食品购买，但效果温和且在不同食品类别间存在异质性。信息干预并未引发远离肉类消费的广泛转变，而是主要导致所购标签产品总体份额增加、标签便利产品购买量上升，以及肉类消费内部的部分重新分配（例如，牛肉购买减少而猪肉购买增加）。我们未发现总体肉类购买量大幅减少或向植物基食品大规模跨类别替代的证据。尽管重度肉类消费者对干预未表现出负面反应，但男性和更倾向右翼的个体表现出适度的行为反弹。总体而言，结果表明，在刺激密集的零售环境中，碳食品标签显著改变习惯性食品消费模式的能力有限，因此应辅以额外的需求侧措施。
title: zero pu“Carbon food labels have limited effects on grocery shopping behavior: Evidence from a randomized experiment”
title_zh: 碳食品标签对杂货购物行为影响有限：来自随机实验的证据
